purpose: Fixed 3..8 module, 5 metre ground walking; requested speeds .22/.26/.30 m/s, measured travel at least .20 m/s; straight and radius 3.33 m curves. Actual load-bearing steps required.

acceptance.failure_test: one-sided Fisher exact with Holm; also review common physical failure mechanisms
acceptance.review_intersection: Explicitly review .30 m/s curved tasks and repeated 3-module tracking / 7-module candidate failures observed during development; do not use nonsignificant omnibus tests as proof of equal performance.

seed_protocol: Fresh independent system-random seeds drawn once after implementation freeze; task inputs and acceptance unchanged.
generation_randomness: Drawn once after fixed source587 (source584 plus regenerated common single-part bounds cache); all failures count, no seed screening or retries.
panel_stopping: Every case keeps the 15 s planning and 10 ms publication acceptance; stop for repair when 80 percent is impossible even if all remaining cases succeed, or on runner error.
procedure_note: Source fixed after development 598: task-driven generation, transverse root seed sign from existing heading, COM feedback 49/14. Fresh generation seed drawn once per unchanged task, before observing any evaluation result. No retries or replacement.
